besluite.fout: 'die ruggraat besluit watter een' is clipped and leaves the reader to supply what is being decided.
besluite.rede: The proposal says plainly that the backbone decides which group an animal falls in, with the same meaning and natural word order.

besluite.fout: The negative with 'geen' is missing its closing 'nie'.
besluite.rede: Required double negative; nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'sag binne 'n harde skulp bly' can read as staying softly rather than being soft.
besluite.rede: Stating 'sag is' first is clearer, parallels the earthworm item and keeps the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'wat vir ander iets wys van hoe hy voel' is awkward.
besluite.rede: 'wat ander iets vertel van hoe hy voel' is the natural idiom; the tail still signals to others how the dog feels.

besluite.fout: 'dele met name wat jy moet ken' is wooden and 'wat' can point to the parts or the names.
besluite.rede: 'waarvan jy die name moet ken' is clear and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: 'Voel ... en jy voel' copies the English 'do X and you will Y' pattern.
besluite.rede: '..., dan voel jy' is the natural Afrikaans form with the same instruction and result.
'dieselfde gebou' is acceptable here, cannot be misread in context, and deliberately echoes the block heading; the swap is lateral.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Comma required by AWS 2017; wording unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses, and bare 'binne'/'buite' after 'dra' is terse.
besluite.rede: The comma is required and 'aan die binnekant/buitekant' reads naturally, matches the heading and keeps the inside-versus-outside contrast.
